title: Lightly Braised Moroccan Lamb Tagine
description: A winey and crispy Moroccan dish featuring carnaroli rice, perfect for a sick day, made with ayurvedic sattvic friendly ingredients.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium high heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the ground cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth, browned lamb, and chopped apricots to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
Stir in the carnaroli rice and continue to simmer, covered, for 30 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Season the tagine with salt and pepper to taste.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
